name: qkd_astk_ep_s-st3a-COMMIT
purpose: KVE-2-ASTK credit-free, lane-free successor of qkd_astk_ep (owner static-cycle rule, HANDOFF 0db): the selected static calendar slice qkd_astk_ep_cal (STATIC 1, HEADS 1) without the P.V-tree lanes (2,716 pass-through pins / flops), the node credit cr (si[633] = engine nb_cr) and the unread so[423:412]; per-slice EXP offset strap eo.  4,365 pins, every pin a register in RTL.

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: st1 (KVE-2-ASTK 10-17): new master qkd_astk_ep_s replaces qkd_astk_ep (ks1 HOLD / ks3 HOLD / ks4 CONGESTION / ks2 NEEDS_RTL): static calendar logic of qkd_astk_ep_cal, no lanes (S / N faces now carry zi / zo only), no credit; recipe 4 flop-first pins, die hold budget; clock on the W face at mid-height (the W-face pin-flop band and the E-face band sit either side of the macro column). || st3 (S-KVASTK 10-18, route st2-71ef7d71e TT -76.5 / FF -2.94 classified on the routed netlist): 0-cycle physical retiming in gen_astk_static.py -- join operand register stage (T compare / bf16 / slot mux / adder operands off the S-face zq and E-face eq wires; u_row one stage shorter, adder y / valid_out are the zo pin registers), running-max compare on Kogge-Stone carry chains (xq -> xo: 13-cell ripple + 192 ps W->E wire), T - 1 - S x 128 and gmax registered (qkd_astk_seq_s), adder ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat_nr (data stages unreset); boundary FF repair 10 ps inside the die budget. Geometry, pins and macros unchanged. || st3a (S-KVASTK 10-18, coord): st3 --cts gate died in routability-driven GPL (GPL-0305, ~18% overflowed tiles, overflow ~4,300; fill 27%) -> same geometry, route.pd 0.5 -> 0.35, GPL_ROUTABILITY_DRIVEN 0; route.io_hold_margin_ns 0.01 -> 0.025 (kit rule >= 25 ps: ~22 ps lost route repair -> sign-off, KV d2d r7t).

reroute_reason.why: st2-71ef7d71e routed NEEDS_RTL (TT -76.5 / FF -2.94); st3 0-cycle physical retiming (join operand stage, KS max compare, registered T terms) + st3a GPL knobs and io_hold_margin_ns 0.025; geometry unchanged
